from PyQt5 import QtWidgets, uic

epsilon = 0.000001


def verif(x):
    if len(x) != 0:
        p = 0
        i = -1
        ok = x[0] != "." and x[len(x) - 1] != "."
        for i in range(len(x)):
            if x[i] == ".":
                p += 1
        ok = ok and p <= 1

        while ok and i < len(x) - 1:
            i += 1
            ok = x[i] == "." or 0 <= int(x[i]) <= 9
        return ok
    else:
        return False


def factoriel(n):
    r = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        r *= i
    return r


def puissance(n, p):
    r = 1
    for i in range(p):
        r *= n
    return r


def SINUS(a):
    if verif(a):
        x = puissance(float(a), 1)
        y = puissance(float(a), 3) / factoriel(3)
        S = 0
        i = 1
        j = 3
        k = 1
        while (x >= epsilon and y >= epsilon) and k < 20:
            S = S + puissance(float(a), i) / factoriel(i)
            S = S - puissance(float(a), j) / factoriel(j)
            x = puissance(float(a), i) / factoriel(i)
            y = puissance(float(a), j) / factoriel(j)
            i += 4
            j += 4
            k += 1
        p.t3.setText(str(S))
    else:
        p.t3.setText("error")


app = QtWidgets.QApplication([])
p = uic.loadUi("SINUS.ui")
p.show()
p.pb1.clicked.connect(lambda: SINUS(p.t1.text()))
app.exec()
